sources.title: Christopher J. Leininger, On groups generated by two positive multi-twists
sources.inspected_scope: Complete listed PDF pages: Sections 3.1-3.2 through Theorems 3.1-3.2; Section 5.1 construction; Lemma 6.3 and its proof; proof of Theorem 6.1 and Proposition 6.4. Theorem 3.1 and 3.2 statements, not original proofs of the deep Teichmuller inputs. Search output also exposed limited introductory/bibliographic lines, not used as theorem-body evidence.
sources.import: Full affine disk stabilizer, hyperbolic derivative/dilatation, unique invariant disk, square construction, faithful two-parabolic representation and exceptions.

sources.title: Robert D. Horowitz, Characters of Free Groups Represented in the Two-Dimensional Special Linear Group
sources.inspected_scope: Listed pages read; universal convention p.636, polynomial-character argument and Corollary 3.14 pp.638-641, complete Example 8.2 and proof pp.648-649. Visual check resolves recurrence exponents and cyclic-word form. No claim of entire-paper inspection.
sources.import: Arbitrarily large universal equal-trace families with nonidentity and nonconjugacy verified in the proof-bearing passage.

sources.title: Benson Farb, Christopher J. Leininger and Dan Margalit, The lower central series and pseudo-Anosov dilatations
sources.inspected_scope: Complete listed pages, particularly lower-central definitions and full Proposition 4.8 proof. Bibliographic search lines for BL and Bers were exposed. Original Bass-Lubotzky paper not retrieved; standard commutator justification independently supplied in DERIVATIONS.md.

sources.title: Tarik Aougab and Samuel J. Taylor, Pseudo-Anosovs optimizing the ratio of Teichmuller to curve graph translation length
sources.inspected_scope: Complete listed pages including full Lemma 2.2 statement and proof. The source proof uses genus-two and genus-three seeds; only the submitted genus-two seed independently reconstructed.
sources.import: Separating filling-pair existence for every g>=2 on the closed surface.

sources.title: Benson Farb, Some problems on mapping class groups and moduli space
sources.inspected_scope: Filtration definitions printed p.14; complete printed pp.49-51 context including Question 7.6 and multiplicity discussion. No other sourcebook chapters inspected.
sources.import: Original target, indexing and source context.

deep_standard_imports_not_reproved: Full disk stabilizer affine realization and hyperbolic derivative classification, collected in Leininger Theorem 3.1
Bers unique invariant disk theorem as explicitly restated in Leininger Theorem 3.2
All-genus separating filling-pair existence, Aougab-Taylor Lemma 2.2
ancillary_search_scope: Two public-web searches attempted to locate the original Bers theorem source. Search snippets, broad result pages, and inaccessible DOI/HTML wrapper are not mathematical evidence and were not used as imported theorem bodies.
